headline: Safeguard exact premixed-vial status during daily dose logging

changes.title: Prevent premature Finished status for premixed vials
changes.detail: Automatic vial depletion now requires verified same-vial dose, waste or correction evidence, rather than kit-wide balance alone. Unattributed older entries cannot retire a specific open vial.
changes.screen: Stash / Today / Log Dose / Combo Dose

changes.title: Protect open premixed vials during preparation
changes.detail: Generic Prepare Dose rollover cannot retire an active premixed vial before physical-ledger commitment; it fails closed without changing inventory.

changes.title: Validate repeated dose logging across days
changes.detail: Fictional automated browser checks cover dose, durable save/readback, reload and next-day dose at 320px and 390px in light and dark modes, including historical unattributed entries.

dataImpact: No migration, automatic reopening, historical Deadpool inventory reconciliation, correction or stock credit. Existing saved records and localStorage key peptide-tracker-html-v1 are retained. Future ordinary user-confirmed dose logs continue to write normally. Fictional DEMO remains isolated, without live writes/import/sync.
limitations: Already-finished historical Deadpool vials and unverified physical remainder remain unchanged; separate user-approved review required before any correction.
Root cause of the user's specific earlier historical event cannot be established without physical/source evidence; the safeguard is preventative.
Separate draft PRs #169 (multi-source Undo) and #173 (historical record review) are excluded.
User-reported iPhone UX acceptance 6/6; VoiceOver and real historical private-data recovery not tested.
Publication pending independent Cloudflare primary-host source parity following merge.
